verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine that exposes model APIs. It is not an application that holds user data or offers an in-product insights or suggestions surface, so 'AI-generated insights from my data inside the product' is the wrong axis for this kind of product. Its OpenAI-compatible serving, tool calling and structured outputs are building blocks a developer could use to construct such a feature elsewhere; they are not this capability.
